We are building an Agentic RAG backend that connects our Robotics Handbook \(docs folder\) to a smart AI chat interface.\\n\\n- Context: Phase 1 \(Textbook\) and Phase 2 \(Homepage\) are successfully implemented. Use FastAPI as the web framework.\\n\\n- Knowledge Base: Target all ''.mdx'' files within the root ''/docs'' folder. Use a Recursive Character Text Splitter \(chunk size: 1000, overlap: 100\).\\n\\n- Vector Search: Use Qdrant Cloud \(Endpoint: https://41561210-ab70-4c14-80a1-7d0a1aae50f8.europe-west3-0.gcp.cloud.qdrant.io\) for high-speed retrieval.\\n\\n- AI Brain: Integrate Gemini-2.0-flash as the primary LLM. It must use a tool-calling ''retrieve'' function to fetch real context from Qdrant.\\n\\n- Embeddings: Use Cohere ''embed-english-v3.0'' with 1024 dimensions for accurate text-to-vector conversion.\\n\\n- Memory & History: Use Neon PostgreSQL to store session-based chat history for every user.\\n\\n- Environment: Define a .env file structure within ''chatbot-backend/'' to protect API keys for Qdrant, Cohere, Gemini, and Neon.\\n\\n- Organization: Store these specifications in ''specs/003-rag-chatbot/spec.md''." -Number 3 -ShortName "rag-chatbot")

Bash(.specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-feature.ps1 -Json """Create a comprehensive specification for Phase 004-rag-chatbot-ui.\\n\\nContext:\\n\\n\\n\\nPhase 001 \(Book Content\), 002 \(Homepage\), and 003 \(Backend\) are complete and verified.\\n\\nWe now need to build a React-based Chatbot UI inside the Docusaurus ''src'' folder that connects to our existing FastAPI/Qdrant backend.\\n\\nRequirements:\\n\\n\\n\\nFolder Structure: UI components must be created in ''src/components/ChatBot/''.\\n\\nComponents: A floating toggle button \(FAB\) and a scrollable Chat Window.\\n\\nFeatures:\\n\\nConnect to endpoints: http://127.0.0.1:8000/chat/start and /chat/{token}/message.\\n\\nRender responses with ''react-markdown'' for technical book content \(code/bold text\).\\n\\nDisplay ''sources'' as clickable badges below bot messages.\\n\\nIntegration: Inject globally via ''src/theme/Root.js'' for site-wide availability.\\n\\nDesign: Clean AI/Robotics theme \(Blue/Slate\) with loading skeletons for a smooth UX.\\n\\nGoal: Generate ''specs/004-rag-chatbot-ui/spec.md'' with these details."""" -Json -Number 4 -ShortName "rag-chatbot-ui" "RAG Chatbot UI ")
